==Format==
*'''Qualifiers''' - ''July 26th - September 21st, 2012''
**Six Regional Qualifiers
***The winners of each Qualifier will advance to the World Championship.
***The runners-up of the China, Europe, and North America Qualifiers will advance to the World Championship.
***The third place team of the Europe and North America Qualifiers will advance to the World Championship.
*'''Group Stage''' - ''October 4th, 2012''
**Eight teams are divided into two groups where they play in a Round Robin format.
***All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
***The top two teams in each group advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
***The remaining teams are eliminated.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''October 5th - October 13th, 2012''
**Eight teams play in a single-elimination format over 4 days.
***Four teams from Group Stage are matched against four teams with direct entry from China, North America, TW/HK/MO, and Europe.
***Four teams from the Group Stage join four teams in the Quarterfinals.
***Finals are {{Abbr/Bo5}}, all other rounds are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
